issues.where: upper-left illuminated face through the center-left terminator, also visible in image-14.png crops B, G, and I and image-15.png crops J and K
issues.what: Most of the globe is smeared into long directional streaks. Crater rims break into offset horizontal strips on the left, while round craters remain legible at center-right.
issues.fix: Check the globe at a frozen pose to distinguish texture distortion from blur. Correct any projection stretch, then shorten the blur or render it with enough temporal samples to retain continuous crater rims.

issues.where: lower shadowed globe, crops S and T, and the shadow transition in U
issues.what: Rectangular and diamond-shaped swatches and isolated bright dashes sit over an otherwise smooth dark surface, giving the terminator a patchy, tiled appearance.
issues.fix: Remove the block-shaped discontinuities in the shadow-side render and blend the terminator continuously while preserving faint, coherent surface detail.

issues.where: near-field crater rim and ridges in crops T, W, and X
issues.what: Parts of the nearest terrain look soft and smeared despite hard, nearly white rim highlights and point glints. The sharper crater floor in image-10.png makes the loss of fine relief noticeable.
issues.fix: Preserve high-frequency detail in the nearest terrain and soften the brightest isolated glints without blurring neighboring rock.
